site_tagline: Binge Minecraft YouTube series from every point of view, in the order it happened.
notice_text: Couchcrab is a fan-made project. We are not affiliated with Hermitcraft or any creator. Every video plays from YouTube on the creator's own channel.
footer_disclaimer: Couchcrab is an independent fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Hermitcraft, its members, any creator listed here, Mojang or Microsoft. All videos are embedded from YouTube and belong to their creators. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang.
page_fallback_notice: This page is not translated yet. It is shown in English.
series_extras_intro: Livestream VODs from this series, in the order they were uploaded. They also have their own page:
series_description_fallback: This description is not translated yet. It is shown in English.
creator_fan_note: Fan-maintained overview. Not run by or affiliated with {name}.
watch_player_failed: The YouTube player could not be loaded. Use the Watch on YouTube link instead.
watch_demo_placeholder: Demo episode: there is no real YouTube video to play here.
signin_intro: You can watch without an account. Signing in syncs your list and progress.
signin_viewers_text: Sync who you watch and your progress, and suggest edits.
signin_creators_text: Sign in with the Google account of your YouTube channel to claim your profile. We only ask YouTube which channels you own. We don't post anything and we don't keep your Google token.
signin_google_details: What Couchcrab asks YouTube and keeps
signin_google_asks: Asks: read-only access to your YouTube account, used once to list the channels this Google account owns.
signin_google_keeps: Keeps: your Google account id, and the id and name of the channels you claim or send for review.
signin_google_never: Never keeps: your Google token, email address, subscriptions or watch history. Couchcrab can't post, comment or change anything on YouTube.
signin_discord_unavailable: Discord sign-in is not set up on this server. Add DISCORD_CLIENT_ID and DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET to enable it.
signin_google_unavailable: Google sign-in is not set up on this server. Add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to enable it.
signin_signed_in: You're signed in as {name}. Continuing with the other service links it to this account.
signin_error_not_configured: This sign-in method is not set up on this server.
signin_error_state: Sign-in took too long or was started in another tab. Please try again.
signin_error_provider: We couldn't finish signing in with that service. Please try again.
signin_error_linked_elsewhere: That account is already linked to another Couchcrab account.
signin_error_other_account_linked: Your Couchcrab account is already linked to a different account of that service.

match.countPlural=one: Signed in with Google. This account owns {count} YouTube channel.
match.countPlural=*: Signed in with Google. This account owns {count} YouTube channels.

claim_none: This Google account doesn't own a YouTube channel. Sign in with the Google account of your channel.
claim_desc_needs_review: Not on Couchcrab yet. We'll add it as your channel after a quick review.
claim_desc_claimed_by_other: {name} was already claimed by another account. If that's wrong, send a creator request.
claim_desc_has_other_profile: Matches {name}, but you already claimed another creator profile.
claim_pick_legend: These channels belong to several creators. Which one are you?
claim_after: After claiming you can edit your profile, manage your channels, place your own videos and hide your videos from Couchcrab if you want.
claim_success: You claimed {name}. Your profile now shows the Verified creator badge.
claim_error_expired: Your channel check has expired. Sign in with Google again to check your channels.
claim_error_not_claimable: This profile can't be claimed. It may have been claimed in the meantime.
claim_no_check: To claim your profile, sign in with the Google account of your YouTube channel. The channel check stays valid for 15 minutes.
setting_creator_captions_only: Only show episodes with creator captions
setting_creator_captions_only_help: Applies to every series unless you change it there. Auto-generated captions don't count.
setting_creator_captions_only_series_hel: Hide episodes without CC in this series
settings_saved_locally: Your settings are saved in this browser.
settings_creators_intro: Pick the creators whose POV you want. Series follow this list unless you change it there.
settings_per_series_intro: Each series follows your global list, or uses its own.
settings_series_global_summary: Follows your global list: {count} of {total} creators
settings_series_intro: Choose whose POV you see in this series. Changing a creator here gives the series its own list.
settings_series_global_hint: This series follows your global list now.
setting_text_only_help: Show episodes as a list of titles, without thumbnails
setting_spoiler_default_help: Every series without its own choice hides the titles of unwatched episodes
setting_captions_on: Turn captions on when a video starts
setting_shortcuts_help: Turn off if you use speech input or a screen reader that conflicts

shortcut_title: Show or hide the real title
